title: 第十五章 嗜血诡树第十六章 无常塔一
content_zh:
果然，沐雨柔祭出一把红色雨伞，悬浮在两人头顶，随着雨伞的旋转，一道红色光幕将两人罩了进去。
然后拿出了一张符向着阵法光幕扔去。
符篆散化为一道流光撞击在光幕上。
“轰...”
的一声巨响，伴随一阵强光，闪的柳辰睁不开眼睛。
然后就是一股能量席卷而来。
还好沐雨柔这次提前做好了准备，否则这股能量绝对能把柳辰冲击的粉碎。
柳辰发现自从遇到沐雨柔，自己的见识跟着涨了不少，很多东西可能是自己正常一辈子都见不到的。
柳辰的胆量也跟着大了不少，这时柳辰非但没有害怕，反而有些期待接下来会遇到什么新奇的东西。
等柳辰睁开眼睛发现之前半圆形的光幕上已经出现一个可供一人进出的缺口。
看来沐雨柔还真是有备而来，还准备了对付阵法的符篆，不过看沐雨柔一脸肉疼的表情，就知道这种能够一击破开阵法的符箓不便宜。
“赶紧走，这个缺口只能维持十个呼吸”
就在柳辰还在惊叹符篆的强大时，沐雨柔催促的声音传来。
柳辰急忙跟上。
等两人进入阵法内部，再看那个缺口果然在能量的流转下慢慢变小，最后消失不见。
柳辰有些庆幸自己没有拖沓，否则还真就进不来了。
他可不认为沐雨柔肯为他浪费一张宝贵的符篆再开一个通道。
虽然这里面不见得安全，但好在天塌下来有高个顶着，这位既然敢来这里探宝肯定有自保的手段。
而且肯带着自己一起柳辰觉得自己有很大把握能活下来，经过这段时间的接触，柳辰发现沐雨柔并不是一个杀性很重的人。
而且他还想着跟在这位修士后面捡些资源宝物呢，不用太多，这位手里随便露点自己就用不清的。

进入内部后柳辰才发现，光幕不止入口这一点。
整个光幕程蛋壳状将山体内部上千平米的空间给全部罩住了。
柳辰着实被这阵法的壮观给震慑住了。
空间内的光线同样不是很好，给人一种昏暗的感觉。
好在这次没有能够吸收光线的阵法，在沐雨柔重新放出几颗火球后，周边环境瞬间明亮了起来。
柳辰环顾一圈发现整个空间不是他想象中的灵气充沛，灵药遍地的洞天福地。
反而给人一种荒凉阴森的恐怖景象。
整个空间除了中间位置的一座高塔，以及塔前的两排奇形怪状的干枯树木外再无它物。
“跟紧我，这里很不对劲，希望不是我想的那样”
柳辰还没来得及问什么情况，就见沐雨柔朝着高塔走去。
很快两人就来到塔前的枯树这里。
这时柳辰才发现这数木着实奇怪，没有叶子就算了，黑色的树身上还有一条条像血管似的红色纹路，让人看了不寒而栗。
content_en:
Sure enough, Mu Yurou held out a red umbrella and floated it above the two of them. As the umbrella rotated, a red light curtain enveloped the two of them.
Then he took out a talisman and threw it towards the formation light screen.
The talisman powder turned into a stream of light and hit the light curtain.
"Boom..."
There was a loud noise, followed by a burst of bright light, which made Liu Chen unable to open his eyes.
Then a wave of energy swept over.
Fortunately, Mu Yurou was prepared in advance this time, otherwise this energy would definitely crush Liu Chen to pieces.
Liu Chen found that since meeting Mu Yurou, his knowledge has increased a lot, and there are many things that he may never see in his normal life.
Liu Chen's courage also grew a lot. At this time, instead of being afraid, Liu Chen was somewhat looking forward to encountering something novel next.
When Liu Chen opened his eyes, he found that a gap for one person to enter and exit had appeared on the semicircular light screen.
It seemed that Mu Yurou was really prepared, and she had prepared talismans to deal with the formation. However, looking at the pained expression on Mu Yurou's face, she knew that such talismans, which could break the formation with one blow, were not cheap.
"Hurry up, this gap can only last ten breaths."
Just when Liu Chen was still marveling at the power of the talisman, Mu Yurou's urging voice came.
Liu Chen hurriedly followed.
When the two of them entered the formation, they saw that the gap slowly became smaller due to the flow of energy, and finally disappeared.
Liu Chen was a little glad that he didn't delay, otherwise he really wouldn't be able to get in.
He didn't think Mu Yurou was willing to waste a precious talisman to open another passage for him.
Although it is not necessarily safe here, fortunately, there is a tall person to hold up if the sky falls. Since this person dares to come here to hunt for treasures, he must have the means to protect himself.
Moreover, Liu Chen felt that he was very confident that he could survive if he was willing to take him with him. After this period of contact, Liu Chen discovered that Mu Yurou was not a very murderous person.
Moreover, he also wanted to follow this monk to pick up some resources and treasures. He didn't need too many, as he wouldn't be able to use them if he just showed some in his hands.
After entering the interior, Liu Chen discovered that the light curtain was more than just the entrance.
The entire light curtain was eggshell-shaped, covering thousands of square meters of space inside the mountain.
Liu Chen was really shocked by the magnificence of this formation.
The light in the space is also not very good, giving people a dim feeling.
Fortunately, there was no formation that could absorb light this time. After Mu Yurou released a few more fireballs, the surrounding environment instantly became brighter.
Liu Chen looked around and found that the entire space was not the cave heaven full of spiritual energy and elixirs that he imagined.
Instead, it gives people a desolate, eerie and terrifying scene.
There is nothing in the entire space except a tall tower in the middle and two rows of strange-shaped dry trees in front of the tower.
"Follow me, something is wrong here. I hope it's not what I think."
Before Liu Chen had time to ask what was going on, he saw Mu Yurou walking towards the tower.
Soon the two came to the dead tree in front of the tower.
Only then did Liu Chen realize that these trees were really strange. Even if they had no leaves, the black trees also had red lines like blood vessels, which made people shudder.
